newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from Monstercat's official Contact Us, Uncaged, Instinct, Silk, music and programming pages, the directly linked LabelRadar portals and LabelRadar's official help documentation. Monstercat states that it listens to every submitted demo and asks for best, original work. Its official contact page links to Uncaged/Instinct and Silk LabelRadar routes; the Monstercat portal covers Uncaged and Instinct, while Silk has a separate portal. Uncaged is the strongest MarcsMusic fit for dubstep, drum-and-bass, trap, breaks and heavy bass; Instinct covers melodic dance, house, pop and indie dance; Silk covers progressive/deep house, trance, ambient and chillout. LabelRadar requires an artist account and five credits per one-to-one label submission. A Lite account receives five free credits monthly when the balance is zero; additional credits and PRO are optional paid products. Activity is current: Monstercat released Vicetone feat. Cozi Zuehlsdorff - Nevada (Gabry Ponte Remix) on July 3, 2026, published Call of the Wild episode 617 on July 8, 2026 and Silk Showcase 862 on July 15, 2026. The public Monstercat support, press and event contacts are not demo alternatives. No account, credit, upload, preview, field, CAPTCHA, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from NCS's official Contact, About, Music Library and Artists pages, the directly linked NCS LabelRadar portal and LabelRadar's official help documentation. NCS identifies itself as a UK electronic label and creator-music platform, officially directs demos to LabelRadar and releases music across House, Dubstep, Trap, Drum & Bass, Electro Pop and many related electronic subgenres. LabelRadar requires an artist account and five credits per direct label submission. A Lite account can receive five credits free each month when the balance is zero; additional credits and PRO are optional paid products. LabelRadar also requires upload and selection of a 20-second preview, and offers optional fan-app exposure. NCS activity is current: its official library lists RIGHT HERE by ZKG on July 14, 2026, Waiting For You by Kkriegerz on July 10 and FLIRT LIGHTS by 2frers on July 9. No public NCS business email was identified as an authorized demo alternative. No account, credit, upload, preview, field, CAPTCHA, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from Steyoyoke's official demo, contact, privacy, homepage and release pages plus current Beatport evidence. The first-party form accepts only a private SoundCloud playlist sent exclusively to Steyoyoke. The artist must confirm that the music has not been sent to other labels and is not being played or tested by other DJs. Visible required fields include Artist Name, Email, Country, Spotify, Instagram and the secret SoundCloud playlist link. A separate required confirmation covers non-infringement, storage for review and contact about the submission; newsletter consent is optional. info@steyoyoke.com, booking@steyoyoke.com, management@steyoyoke.com, licensing@steyoyoke.com, shop@steyoyoke.com and jobs@steyoyoke.com are first-party, syntactically valid and domain-aligned business contacts, but none is published as a demo alternative. The site exposed a Cloudflare/browser-verification page during passive open, which was not bypassed. Activity is current: the official catalogue shows Steyoyoke Anniversary Vol. 15 and newer releases, and Beatport lists Steyoyoke anniversary tracks dated May 15, 2026. No form field, playlist, checkbox, browser challenge, email, account, payment or submission was used.
